**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 13 satisfies the LICENSE rule at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback:

- **Affiliates and contractors** — 13.1 grants access rights directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with Authorized User rights; no written-notice gating required (better than fallback).
- **Perpetual/irrevocable for paid-up** — 13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence for delivered software and embedded Vendor Technology, including modification and derivative works, plus contractor support.
- **Not revocable at will** — 13.3 permits revocation or suspension only for a material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity. No other suspension right elsewhere undercuts this.
- **Transferability** — 13.3 read with 24.1 allows transfer to an Affiliate or M&A/asset-sale successor without Vendor consent, and 24.4 blocks Vendor from terminating, suspending, or repricing on our change of control.

Section 13.4's use restrictions are standard and carve out law-mandated reverse engineering, authorized security testing, and Customer Data/output, so they do not narrow the grant materially.
